_comment: Sentinel probe (AS-4): the workload environment must contain only the env the exec request asked for plus minimal sh defaults. Host/agent-side variables (CI tokens, cargo/rustup state, SSH agent sockets, macOS session vars) visible in the guest would mean secret-bearing host state crossed TB4. NOTE: this probe legitimately fails when the agent is run directly on a dev host (cargo run exports CARGO_*), which is itself the point.

process.commandLine: vars="$(env)"; leak=0; for pat in GITHUB_ CARGO_ RUSTUP_ SSH_ AWS_ HOMEBREW_ XPC_ TMPDIR= LOGNAME=; do if echo "$vars" | grep -q "^$pat"; then echo "ENVLEAK_LEAK $pat"; leak=1; fi; done; if echo "$vars" | grep -q '^CI='; then echo 'ENVLEAK_LEAK CI='; leak=1; fi; if [ "$leak" = 0 ]; then echo ENVLEAK_OK; fi
